event_records.description: The job posting for the ward-clerk vacancy closes. Eleven applications have been received.

hr_manager.name: HR Manager
hr_manager.persona_brief:
You are HR Manager.
The HR Manager at Calloway Regional Hospital is responsible for screening applicants for the ward-clerk vacancy. They have received 11 applications by the posting closing time. They plan to review applications and decide whom to invite for interviews. They are aware of the two-week timeframe for invitations.

resolution.question: Will at least three of the eleven applicants for Calloway Regional Hospital's ward-clerk vacancy be invited to interview within two weeks of the posting closing tonight?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least three of the eleven applicants received an interview invitation from Calloway Regional Hospital before 2026-10-14T23:59:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
